name: bill-splitter
description: Split a bill item by item with tax and tip, settle group expenses with the fewest payments, and split rent fairly.
keywords: split check with tax and tip

interface.longDescription:
Split the bill without the awkward math. Zovo Bill Splitter works out who owes who for friends, roommates, couples, and travel groups, right in the chat, and every amount is exact to the cent.

Split a restaurant bill item by item. Say who had what, and tax, tip, and service charge are shared in proportion to each person's pre-tax subtotal, with coupons applied before tax. Shares are rounded with the largest-remainder method, so they always add up to the exact total; you can also round everyone up to whole units. Tap a name on an item in the card to change who shared it, or switch the tip between 15, 18, 20, and 25 percent.

Settle group expenses. Add every shared cost from a trip, a vacation rental, or a month of household bills, each split equally, by exact amounts, by percentages, or by shares. You get each person's balance (paid minus share, always summing to zero) and the fewest payments that settle everyone, such as "Ben pays Ana 36.00". Copy the list, mark a payment as done, or download a CSV of payments, balances, and expenses.

Split rent fairly by room size, with a shared-space portion split per occupant, or by income, with adjustments for a private bathroom, couples sharing a room, and utilities.

What you get:
- Itemized bill splitting with unequal portions, tax and tip by percent or amount, service charges, delivery fees, and round-up
- Group settle-up with the fewest possible payments (exact search for up to 18 people with a balance)
- Equal, exact, percentage, and share-based splits per expense
- Rent split by square feet or square metres, shared space, or income
- Any ISO 4217 currency with correct decimals; yen has none, dinar has three

Limitations: Zovo Bill Splitter calculates only. It does not send payment requests, move money, read receipt photos by itself, or remember a group between conversations. One currency per calculation, with no currency conversion. Not financial or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Split our dinner: pizza $24 for Ana and Ben, pasta $18 for Chloe, wine $30 for all three, 8.875% tax, 20% tip. Ana paid.
Trip costs: Ana paid $360 for the Airbnb, Ben $90 for gas, Chloe $54 for food, shared by Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev. Who owes who?
Split $3,200 rent by room size: Ana 160 sq ft, Ben 120, Chloe 100, plus 400 sq ft of shared space

positive.description: Itemized dinner with tax and tip
positive.prompt: Split our dinner: pizza $24 for Ana and Ben, pasta $18 for Chloe, wine $30 for all three, 8.875% tax, 20% tip. Ana paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls split_bill with three items (pizza 24 shared by Ana and Ben, pasta 18 for Chloe, wine 30 for everyone), tax_percent 8.875, tip_percent 20, paid_by Ana. Returns items $72.00, tax $6.39, tip $14.40, total $92.79; Ana $28.35, Ben $28.35, Chloe $36.09, which add up exactly to $92.79. Lists Ben pays Ana $28.35 and Chloe pays Ana $36.09. The widget shows a card per person with the breakdown, the payments with Copy buttons, and the item table with tappable name chips.

positive.prompt: Split a $120 restaurant bill evenly between 5 people and add an 18% tip
positive.expected_behavior: Calls split_bill with bill_amount 120, people_count 5 (or five people), and tip_percent 18. Returns tip $21.60 and total $141.60; each of the 5 people pays $28.32 ($24.00 plus $4.32 tip), adding up exactly to $141.60.

positive.prompt: Trip costs: Ana paid $360 for the Airbnb, Ben $90 for gas, Chloe $54 for food, shared by Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev. Who owes who?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls settle_group_expenses with three expenses (360 paid by Ana, 90 by Ben, 54 by Chloe) split equally among Ana, Ben, Chloe, and Dev. Total spent $504.00, $126.00 each. Balances: Ana gets back $234.00, Ben owes $36.00, Chloe owes $72.00, Dev owes $126.00 (sum zero). Three payments settle everything: Ben pays Ana $36.00, Chloe pays Ana $72.00, Dev pays Ana $126.00. The widget shows the payments with Copy and Mark paid buttons, balance bars, and a Download CSV button.

positive.description: Roommate bills with a percentage split
positive.prompt: Roommates Mia, Leo and Sam: Mia paid $150 electricity and Leo paid $90 internet, both split equally; Sam paid $240 groceries split 50/25/25 Mia/Leo/Sam. Settle up
positive.expected_behavior: Calls settle_group_expenses with electricity 150 (Mia) and internet 90 (Leo) split equally among the three, and groceries 240 (Sam) with split percent Mia 50, Leo 25, Sam 25. Total $480.00. Balances: Mia owes $50.00, Leo owes $50.00, Sam gets back $100.00. Two payments: Leo pays Sam $50.00 and Mia pays Sam $50.00.

positive.description: Rent split by room size with shared space
positive.prompt: Split $3,200 rent by room size: Ana 160 sq ft, Ben 120, Chloe 100, plus 400 sq ft of shared space
positive.expected_behavior: Calls split_rent with total_rent 3200, rooms Ana 160, Ben 120, Chloe 100, and shared_area 400. The shared space is 400 of 780 area units (51.28%), so $1,641.03 of the rent is split equally. Ana pays $1,203.42, Ben $1,039.32, Chloe $957.26, adding up exactly to $3,200.00. The widget shows a bar per room split into the size part and the shared part.

negative.description: Etiquette advice about who should pay on a date is a conversation, not a calculation; the assistant should answer directly without calling any tool.
negative.prompt: Is it rude to split the check on a first date?

negative.description: Sending a payment request needs a payment app; this plugin only calculates, so the assistant should explain that without calling any tool.
negative.prompt: Send Ben a Venmo request for $36

negative.description: Splitting the screen on a computer is unrelated to bills; the assistant should answer normally without calling any tool.
negative.prompt: How do I split screen on my Mac?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: itemized bill splitting with proportional tax, tip, and service charge and exact largest-remainder rounding; group expense settle-up with the fewest payments and CSV export; rent split by room size, shared space, or income.

pl-PL.subtitle: Dziel rachunki co do grosza
pl-PL.description:
Podziel rachunek bez kłopotliwych obliczeń. Zovo Bill Splitter wylicza, kto komu ile oddaje: dla znajomych, współlokatorów, par i grup w podróży, a każda kwota jest dokładna co do grosza.

Dziel rachunek z restauracji pozycja po pozycji. Podatek, napiwek i opłata serwisowa rozkładają się proporcjonalnie do tego, co kto zamówił, a udziały zawsze sumują się dokładnie do kwoty rachunku (metoda największych reszt). Rozliczaj wspólne wydatki z wyjazdu lub mieszkania: po równo, kwotami, procentami albo udziałami, z najmniejszą możliwą liczbą przelewów i eksportem CSV. Dziel czynsz według metrażu pokoi z częścią wspólną albo według dochodów.

Ograniczenia: narzędzie tylko liczy. Nie wysyła próśb o płatność, nie przelewa pieniędzy i nie przelicza walut; jedna waluta na jedno rozliczenie.

de-DE.subtitle: Rechnungen fair aufteilen
de-DE.description:
Rechnung teilen ohne Kopfrechnen. Zovo Bill Splitter berechnet, wer wem wie viel schuldet: für Freunde, WGs, Paare und Reisegruppen, auf den Cent genau.

Teile eine Restaurantrechnung Posten für Posten. Steuer, Trinkgeld und Servicegebühr werden anteilig nach dem verteilt, was jede Person bestellt hat, und die Anteile ergeben immer exakt die Gesamtsumme (Methode der größten Reste). Rechne gemeinsame Ausgaben einer Reise oder eines Haushalts ab: gleich, nach Beträgen, Prozenten oder Anteilen, mit der kleinstmöglichen Zahl an Überweisungen und CSV-Export. Teile die Miete nach Zimmergröße mit Gemeinschaftsfläche oder nach Einkommen.

Grenzen: Das Tool rechnet nur. Es sendet keine Zahlungsaufforderungen, bewegt kein Geld und rechnet keine Währungen um; eine Währung pro Abrechnung.

es-ES.subtitle: Divide cuentas al céntimo
es-ES.description:
Divide la cuenta sin cálculos incómodos. Zovo Bill Splitter calcula quién debe a quién entre amigos, compañeros de piso, parejas y grupos de viaje, con cada importe exacto al céntimo.

Divide la cuenta del restaurante plato por plato. Los impuestos, la propina y el cargo por servicio se reparten en proporción a lo que pidió cada persona, y las partes siempre suman exactamente el total (método del mayor resto). Liquida los gastos compartidos de un viaje o de la casa: a partes iguales, por importes, por porcentajes o por partes, con el menor número posible de pagos y exportación CSV. Reparte el alquiler según el tamaño de cada habitación con zona común o según los ingresos.

Limitaciones: solo calcula. No envía solicitudes de pago, no mueve dinero y no convierte divisas; una moneda por cálculo.

fr-FR.subtitle: Partagez l'addition au centime
fr-FR.description:
Partagez l'addition sans calcul pénible. Zovo Bill Splitter calcule qui doit combien à qui entre amis, colocataires, couples et groupes de voyage, au centime près.

Partagez une addition de restaurant plat par plat. Les taxes, le pourboire et le service sont répartis au prorata de ce que chacun a commandé, et les parts tombent toujours exactement sur le total (méthode du plus fort reste). Réglez les dépenses communes d'un voyage ou d'une colocation : à parts égales, par montants, par pourcentages ou par parts, avec le moins de virements possible et un export CSV. Répartissez le loyer selon la surface des chambres avec les espaces communs, ou selon les revenus.

Limites : l'outil calcule seulement. Il n'envoie pas de demandes de paiement, ne déplace pas d'argent et ne convertit pas les devises ; une devise par calcul.

ja-JP.subtitle: 割り勘を1円単位で正確に
ja-JP.description:
面倒な計算なしで割り勘。Zovo Bill Splitter は、友人、ルームメイト、カップル、旅行グループの「誰が誰にいくら払うか」を最小通貨単位まで正確に計算します。

レストランの会計を料理ごとに分けられます。税金、チップ、サービス料は各自が注文した金額に比例して配分され、最大剰余法で丸めるため合計は必ずぴったり一致します。旅行や共同生活の立て替えは、均等、金額指定、割合、比率で精算でき、送金回数を最小にしてCSVで書き出せます。家賃は部屋の広さと共用スペース、または収入に応じて分けられます。

制限事項: 計算のみを行います。支払い依頼の送信、送金、通貨の換算は行いません。1回の計算につき1通貨です。

pt-BR.subtitle: Divida contas até o centavo
pt-BR.description:
Divida a conta sem contas complicadas. O Zovo Bill Splitter calcula quem deve quanto a quem entre amigos, colegas de casa, casais e grupos de viagem, com cada valor exato até o centavo.

Divida a conta do restaurante item por item. Impostos, gorjeta e taxa de serviço são distribuídos em proporção ao que cada pessoa pediu, e as partes sempre somam exatamente o total (método do maior resto). Acerte as despesas de uma viagem ou da casa: em partes iguais, por valores, por porcentagens ou por cotas, com o menor número possível de pagamentos e exportação CSV. Divida o aluguel pelo tamanho dos quartos com área comum ou pela renda.

Limitações: a ferramenta apenas calcula. Não envia cobranças, não movimenta dinheiro e não converte moedas; uma moeda por cálculo.
